annotations.title: Send a test lead through an Instant Form

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Sends a Meta test lead (no ad spend, nothing billed) to one of the brand's Instant Forms (formId from ads_lead_forms_list), waits for it to reach flayr and for the follow-up email or sequence, then deletes it. Returns a run with status creating or waiting; poll ads_lead_form_test_lead_status until it is passed or failed and read `message`. The follow-up goes to your own email. Meta keeps one test lead per form, so one run per form at a time (409 TEST_RUNNING).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/{formId}/test-lead.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

formId.description: The Meta Instant Form id (digits), from GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms.

name: ads_lead_form_test_lead
title: Send a test lead through an Instant Form
